deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve Cardano KPIs including monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs: monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue development of KPI tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data and repeated KPI reporting cadence.
Operate review, debate, temperature check, final voting, milestone validation, and transparent disbursement processes for funded projects.
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury after completion of approved work, governance processes, or funding activities.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds initially received and administered by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Cardano Builder DAO treasury withdrawal to continue and expand a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders aligned with Vision 2030 metrics.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism to support projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 through measurable KPIs.
The proposal identifies monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL as the core KPIs its funded projects are intended to improve and track.
The DAO says it built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, moving from self-reported KPI tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO claims it has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

Round 1 is claimed to have included 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, 83% governance participation, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 is claimed to have added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The DAO claims it created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain with transparency.

The proposal states that an independent council composed of dRep DAO members will receive the treasury withdrawal, hold funds before deployment, and oversee milestone-based disbursement through an independent multisig.
The proposal states administrator-held ADA will be kept in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to a stake pool, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The DAO claims it returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after its first two governance rounds, citing an AdaStat transaction.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue and scale a KPI-driven builder funding mechanism, citing prior funding rounds, KPI dashboard work, governance participation, administrator controls, milestone disbursement, and a prior unused-funds repayment transaction.
